title: 第7章 有妖兽第8章 去杀掉它
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
没齿难忘？
一把躺椅而已，怎么就没齿难忘了？
我这师妹是不是真脑子有问题？
不过她昨晚在躺椅上睡觉，怎么突破的修为？
“对了师妹，你突破了？”
林清瑶经他提醒，这才回过神来，连忙内视己身。
片刻后，她脸上绽放出难以置信的光芒：“没错师兄，我突破了！
现在是筑基二重了！”
“师兄法器实在玄妙！
师妹只是在其上安睡一宿，竟有如此神效！”
法器？
陆鸣直接懵了。
他虽然不能修炼，但穿越前也没少看各种玄幻小说。
小说中可从来没听说过躺着睡一觉就能突破境界这种离谱的事情。
这又不是玩游戏挂机涨经验。
难道……难道我这师妹根本不是什么资质平平的废柴，而是那种万年难遇、睡觉都能升级的天选之子？绝世天才？
所以各峰首座其实都看走眼了？
宗主这是误打误撞给烟霞峰送了个宝贝过来？
陆鸣试探道：“师妹，你是说你就在那椅子上睡了一觉，然后就突破了？”
“正是！”

林清瑶用力的点点头：“我躺在师兄的法器上后，便觉心神宁静祥和，周身暖融舒适，体内灵气自行增长！”
“应该是我睡着之后，自行突破的。”
等等，什么玩意？
躺在我的躺椅上灵气就自行增长？
可我这躺椅是我用峰中的凡竹自己做的。
那玩意儿除了躺着比较舒服外还有这功能？
我怎么不知道？
想到这里，陆鸣疑惑了起来。
林清瑶没必要也没理由骗他。
何况，昨日在宗门大殿，宗主玄辉真人也亲口说过林清瑶的天资不行。
其他几位峰主都没看上她，所以才要将她塞进烟霞峰。
也就是说林清瑶拥有妖孽天资这件事，绝对不可能。
倘若她天资独绝，其他几位峰主又怎么会不要她？
这么说来……
林清瑶说的是真的？
陆鸣回头看了看那张在晨光中显得平平无奇的摇椅，又看了看眼前一脸欣喜的林清瑶。
难道是因为我这系统的原因？
这无敌领域，不止是我本身无敌。
而是经由我手的东西，都会带上某种道蕴？
毕竟，我的系统名字就叫【天演大道领域】。
content_en:
Unforgettable?
It’s just a recliner, why can’t it be forgotten?
Is there really something wrong with my junior sister's brain?
But she slept on the recliner last night, how did she achieve such a breakthrough?
"By the way, junior sister, have you made a breakthrough?"
After being reminded by him, Lin Qingyao came back to her senses and quickly looked inside herself.
After a moment, her face shone with incredible light: "Yes, senior brother, I have a breakthrough!
Now it’s the second level of foundation building! "
“Senior Brother’s magic weapon is really mysterious!
Junior sister just slept on it for one night, but it had such a magical effect! "
Magic weapon?
Lu Ming was stunned.
Although he couldn't practice cultivation, he read various fantasy novels before traveling through time.
In novels, I have never heard of such outrageous things as being able to break through the realm by just lying down and sleeping.
This is not about playing games to gain experience.
Could it be... Could it be that my junior sister is not a loser with mediocre qualifications at all, but the kind of chosen one who is rare in thousands of years and can be upgraded in his sleep? Unparalleled genius?
So the top of each peak is actually wrong?
Did the sect master send a treasure to Yanxia Peak by mistake?
Lu Ming probed: "Junior sister, are you saying that you slept on that chair and then broke through?"
"Exactly!"
Lin Qingyao nodded vigorously: "After I lay on my senior brother's magic weapon, I felt calm and peaceful, my whole body felt warm and comfortable, and the spiritual energy in my body grew on its own!"
"I should have broken through on my own after I fell asleep."
Wait, what the hell?
Just lying on my recliner will your spiritual energy grow on its own?
But I made my recliner myself using bamboo from the peak.
In addition to being more comfortable when lying down, does that thing also have this function?
How come I don't know?
Thinking of this, Lu Ming became confused.
Lin Qingyao had no need or reason to lie to him.
What's more, yesterday in the sect's main hall, the sect leader Xuan Hui himself said that Lin Qingyao's talent was not good.
The other peak masters didn't take a fancy to her, so they had to stuff her into Yanxia Peak.
In other words, it is absolutely impossible for Lin Qingyao to have the talent to be a monster.
If she is uniquely talented, why would the other peak masters not want her?
Put it this way...
Is what Lin Qingyao said true?
Lu Ming looked back at the rocking chair that looked ordinary in the morning light, and then at Lin Qingyao who looked happy in front of him.
Is it because of my system?
This invincible field is not only invincible to me.
But everything that passes through my hands will have some kind of Tao aggregate?
After all, the name of my system is [Tianyan Avenue Domain].
